workflow: Built-in image_gen; original synthetic illustrations, no third-party photographs redistributed. Local resize and PNG/WebP encoding after generation.
portraitTemplate: Use case: historical-scene. Create one square Epoch strategy game leader portrait of the actual {person}. Authentic recognizable likeness, respectful realistic oil-painted portrait, detailed facial anatomy, head and shoulders to mid chest, face large and clearly readable at 64px, slight three-quarter pose looking toward viewer, entire hair visible with small headroom. Muted warm brown/olive softly textured studio background, subdued warm side lighting, realistic colors, fine painterly texture matching classical historical strategy game portraits. No frame, no text, no flags, no watermark, no caricature, no other people. Output one square portrait.
roomTemplate: Use case: historical-scene. Epoch strategy game Audience background. Wide cinematic 21:9 realistic oil-painted scene in {room}. Depict the actual recognizable {person} at the right quarter of the image, full body or seated appropriately, facing the viewer naturally with calm expression, authentic period clothing. One person only. Warm subdued lighting, dark wood and softly lit furnishings. Left 55 percent is quiet darker room space for game UI overlay. Entire person comfortably within frame. Detailed recognizable actual face, never generic substitute. Restrained classical painterly realism, not cartoon. No text, no logos, no watermark, no captions.
